capability: 视频生成（文生视频 / 图生视频-首帧、首尾帧 / 全模态参考生视频，1080p 25fps 原生同步音画）

gateway.source_claim: 网关执行档案：video_contract.go 的 operationAllowed 对 magi-2 允许 text_to_video / first_frame / first_last_frame / video_multi_ref

sources.claim: Sand AI 官方模型 ID 为 magi-2，输出分辨率 1080p，官方按秒标价 0.08 USD/s
MAGI-2 为 480B 总参数（约 28B 激活参数）模型，支持 6 种宽高比、最长 30 秒 1080p 25fps，支持最多 20 个全模态参考（最多 10 张图、5 段视频、5 段音频）
sources.quote: MAGI-2 scales the base model more than 4× to 480B total parameters and ~28B active parameters. It supports six aspect ratios, generates up to 30 seconds at 1080p and 25 fps, combines up to 20 references (up to 10 images, 5 videos, and 5 audio clips) via omni-reference

sources.claim: 文本提示词上限 15000 个 Unicode 字符；分辨率仅支持 1080p；generateAudio 默认 true；seed 范围 0 至 4294967295；媒体链接须为公开 HTTPS URL 且不超过 8192 字符
sources.quote: Include exactly one nonblank text item of up to 15,000 Unicode code points. Only 1080p is supported. Defaults to 1080p when omitted, null, empty or whitespace-only. generateAudio Defaults to true. Audio references are accepted even when set to false. seed A value from 0 to 4294967295, inclusive, fixes the seed. A public HTTPS download URL of up to 8,192 characters.

sources.claim: 输出时长范围 4–30 秒整数，支持 6 种宽高比 21:9/16:9/4:3/1:1/3:4/9:16；首帧与首尾帧或含任意参考媒体（含纯音频）时文本提示词可选
sources.quote: Required. Output duration of 4–30 seconds, inclusive. ratio: 21:9, 16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4, 9:16. Frame inputs accept a first frame alone or a first and last frame together. The roles identify the frames in either array order. A prompt is optional. With any media, including audio alone, text is optional. At most one text item of up to 15,000 Unicode code points.

sources.claim: 参考素材限制：图片 0–10 张（JPEG/PNG/WebP/BMP/TIFF/GIF/HEIC/HEIF，单张小于 30000000 字节）；视频 0–5 段（MP4/MOV，单段不超过 200000000 字节、2–30 s、总时长 ≤30 s）；音频 0–5 段（WAV/MP3，单段不超过 15000000 字节、2–30 s、总时长 ≤30 s）
sources.quote: Image JPEG / PNG / WebP / BMP / TIFF / GIF / HEIC / HEIF Under 30,000,000 bytes Up to 10. Video MP4 / MOV (H.264 / H.265) ≤ 200,000,000 bytes, 2–30 s Up to 5, ≤ 30 s total. Audio WAV / MP3 ≤ 15,000,000 bytes, 2–30 s Up to 5, ≤ 30 s total.

sources.claim: 网关执行档案：video_contract.go 的 operationAllowed 对 magi-2 允许 text_to_video / first_frame / first_last_frame / video_multi_ref
sources.quote: "magi-2": { opTextToVideo: true, opFirstFrame: true, opFirstLastFrame: true, opVideoMultiRef: true, },

notes: Sand AI 官方文档（platform.sand.ai/docs 与 sand.ai/blog/magi-2）已完整核验。MAGI-2 仅支持 1080p 单档分辨率（25fps），不支持 adaptive 宽高比与自动时长 -1；首帧/首尾帧与全模态参考模式均使用 6 种显式宽高比（默认 16:9），且 generate_audio 默认开启且不另加价。参考图片/视频/音频单文件字节上限直接采用官方公布的十进制字节值（30,000,000 / 200,000,000 / 15,000,000）。
